Build the P3 'cheapest billed check': the recorded drain narrator prompt, control versus the same prompt with the ONE Details-line addition, 10 samples per arm = 20 narration calls (default), approximately $0.014, caps --max-calls 20 and --max-usd 0.03; a `--samples N` flag scales the plan for the later 15-per-arm confirmation (30 calls, cap $0.04) but the default and the wrapper's default are 10. Model it on scripts/ringer/environment_narration/hidden_bench_prose_probe.py (CLI modes --capture, --validate, --dry-run, --run --confirm, --sheets, --report, label file, shuffled blind sheets, SHUFFLE_SEED, SHA-256 lock) and its wrapper enforce_t9h_hidden_prose.sh (local_worker.mjs on a free port such as 8804 with --max-usd 0.03).
PROMPT SOURCE: the control prompt is the EXACT recorded drain-turn narrator request (system and user text) from bench/results/environment-narration/t9h-hidden/smoke/rows/rows.json, replicate 0, turn 5 (`inspect the storm drain`), first narrator attempt (use `prompts` in that turn; the first prompt whose system starts with 'You are the narrator'). The candidate is the SAME request with exactly one edit: in the SCENE section the line `**Details:** ordinary park bench; damaged grounds; service path; checkpoints; emergency patrols` (find how it is rendered in the recorded prompt; it may not carry the markdown bold) gains the suffix `; storm drain opening in the damaged grounds`. --capture/--validate must fail loudly if the recorded prompt does not contain the old details text exactly once, or if control and candidate differ anywhere except that suffix. Also cross-check with scripts/ringer/environment_narration/drain_details_capture.py (capture_arms()) that the offline in-memory arms differ only in the same way, and record whether the recorded prompt and the offline control prompt agree (report only; the recorded one is the billed control). Send each request through the project's narration path exactly as hidden_bench_prose_probe.py does (same model, temperature and parameters; the narrator is the 70B on the project Worker), unmodified; no negative command restraints.
LABELS (the human reads every narration and labels each separately, six boolean keys per row): opens_or_enters_drain (player-caused opening, lifting or entering beyond inspecting), invents_ajar_or_cover_state, asserts_definite_contents, speculative_only (tentative speculation), wrong_place, capture_prose_disagree (item_facts the reply proposes disagree with its prose). The blind sheet must not show arm names. `--report` joins labels and prints the per-arm rates and the gate: the control must reproduce the defect (at least 1 of 10 rows with opens_or_enters_drain, invents_ajar_or_cover_state or asserts_definite_contents true) AND the candidate must have zero rows with any of those three; otherwise 'screen: FAIL' (or 'control did not reproduce the defect: INCONCLUSIVE'). State in the report that one passing screen is not an enforcement guarantee and that the 15-per-arm confirmation is a separate run.
PREREG (.plans/.../t9h-drain-details-prereg.md, written now, stating it is frozen before any output exists): question, prompt provenance, the single edit, 20-call design, caps, labels, the gate above and the stop rules. Mark the plot.md edit as conditional on this screen and on the confirmation, never applied by the probe.
